title: Kantor workbook (kantor sheets build) and sheets editing tools (kantor sheets edit)

sheets.description: The sheets, in tab order. Each sheet's parts are made in this order: rows/columns/cells, formats, widths, heights, tables, conditional formats, validation, charts, pivots, freeze, page setup, ops.

names.description: Defined names, made before the sheets' contents.

active.description: The sheet shown when the file opens.

ops.description: Editing tools run after every sheet is made.

style.description: thin (default), medium, thick, double, dotted, dashed, hair, dashDot, dashDotDot, mediumDashed, mediumDashDot, mediumDashDotDot, slantDashDot.

write_range_args.description: Write rows of values and formulas ("=...") from a top-left cell, as typed. null leaves a cell, "" clears it.

sheet.description: Sheet name, or its number from 1 (default: the active sheet). References such as Data!A1:B9 name their own sheet.

top_left.description: The first cell, e.g. A1 or Data!B2.

values.description: Rows of cells from top_left: text, numbers, booleans, formulas ("=SUM(B2:B9)"), null to leave a cell, "" to clear it. Text that looks like a number stays text with a leading apostrophe ("'00123").

write_columns_args.description: Write columns of values from a top-left cell: each inner array is one column, top to bottom.

sheet.description: Sheet name, or its number from 1 (default: the active sheet). References such as Data!A1:B9 name their own sheet.

top_left.description: The first cell, e.g. A1 or Data!B2.

columns.description: Columns of cells from top_left, each top to bottom.

clear_args.description: Clear the contents of a range (formats stay).

sheet.description: Sheet name, or its number from 1 (default: the active sheet). References such as Data!A1:B9 name their own sheet.

range.description: Cells: A1:D20, Data!A1:D20, whole columns C:E or rows 3:5.

fill_down_args.description: Copy the top row of a range down through it, formulas adjusting their relative references (Ctrl+D). With `formula`, that formula is written to the top row first. A single cell fills down to the last row of the data beside it.

sheet.description: Sheet name, or its number from 1 (default: the active sheet). References such as Data!A1:B9 name their own sheet.

range.description: Cells: A1:D20, Data!A1:D20, whole columns C:E or rows 3:5.

formula.description: A formula with =, its references as for the first cell (they adjust as it fills).

fill_right_args.description: Copy the left column of a range across it (Ctrl+R); `formula` is written to it first.

sheet.description: Sheet name, or its number from 1 (default: the active sheet). References such as Data!A1:B9 name their own sheet.

range.description: Cells: A1:D20, Data!A1:D20, whole columns C:E or rows 3:5.

formula.description: A formula with =, its references as for the first cell (they adjust as it fills).

format_args.description: Format a range: font, size, bold, colours, fill, alignment, wrap, number format (a preset or any Excel code), indent, rotation, borders, merge.

sheet.description: Sheet name, or its number from 1 (default: the active sheet). References such as Data!A1:B9 name their own sheet.

range.description: Cells: A1:D20, Data!A1:D20, whole columns C:E or rows 3:5.

font_size_delta.description: Grow (or shrink) the font by this many points.

number_format.description: An Excel number format code ("#,##0.00", "0.0%", "\"Rp\"#,##0", "dd/mm/yyyy", "@" for text) or a preset: general (General), number (#,##0.00), integer (#,##0), decimal1 (#,##0.0), percent (0.0%), percent0 (0%), percent2 (0.00%), rupiah ("Rp"#,##0), dollar ("$"#,##0.00), euro ([$€-x-euro2] #,##0.00), date (yyyy-mm-dd), datetime (yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm), time (hh:mm), text (@).

rotation.description: Text angle in degrees, -90 to 90 (counter-clockwise), or 255 for stacked letters.

borders.description: Borders: all, outline, inside, top, bottom, left, right, inside_horizontal, inside_vertical, none; or {edges, style (thin, medium, thick, double, dotted, dashed, hair, dashDot, ...), color}; or a list of these.

merge.description: true merges the range (Merge & Center), false unmerges it.

column_width_args.description: Set column widths in characters (Excel's unit; 8.43 is the default), or "auto" to fit their contents.

sheet.description: Sheet name, or its number from 1 (default: the active sheet). References such as Data!A1:B9 name their own sheet.

columns.description: A column (C), a span (A:F) or a list of them.

width.description: Width in characters (Excel's unit; the default column is 8.43), or "auto".

autofit_args.description: Widen columns to fit their contents (estimated from the text, as Excel's double-click does).

row_height_args.description: Set row heights in points (15 is the default for 11 pt text).

rows.description: A row number from 1, or a span such as "5:9".

cell.description: The first cell that scrolls: B2 freezes row 1 and column A; A1 unfreezes.

sheet_view_args.description: How a sheet shows on screen: `show_gridlines` false hides the gridlines (Excel's View > Gridlines; printing them is page_setup's `gridlines`).

descending.description: Every key descending (unless it gives its order).

header.description: The range's first row is a header (default: sort and remove_duplicates guess, add_table assumes true).

remove_duplicates_args.description: Delete rows of a range that repeat an earlier row (in `columns`, default all), keeping the first. Compares values, ignoring case and surrounding spaces.

to_numbers_args.description: Turn numbers stored as text ("1,234.50", "Rp 12.000", "(500)", "15%") into numbers. `decimal`: ".", "," or "auto". `number_format` is applied to the whole range (numbers already there too).

sheet.description: Sheet name, or its number from 1 (default: the active sheet). References such as Data!A1:B9 name their own sheet.

range.description: Cells: A1:D20, Data!A1:D20, whole columns C:E or rows 3:5.

decimal.description: The decimal separator in the text (auto: from the texts; Rupiah amounts such as "Rp 12.000" group with dots either way).

number_format.description: An Excel number format code ("#,##0.00", "0.0%", "\"Rp\"#,##0", "dd/mm/yyyy", "@" for text) or a preset: general (General), number (#,##0.00), integer (#,##0), decimal1 (#,##0.0), percent (0.0%), percent0 (0%), percent2 (0.00%), rupiah ("Rp"#,##0), dollar ("$"#,##0.00), euro ([$€-x-euro2] #,##0.00), date (yyyy-mm-dd), datetime (yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm), time (hh:mm), text (@).

to_dates_args.description: Turn dates stored as text ("15/01/2026", "2026-01-15", "15 Jan 2026", "15 Januari 2026") into dates. `order`: dmy, mdy, ymd or auto. `number_format` (default yyyy-mm-dd) is applied to the whole range when given, else to the converted cells and the range's existing dates.

sheet.description: Sheet name, or its number from 1 (default: the active sheet). References such as Data!A1:B9 name their own sheet.

range.description: Cells: A1:D20, Data!A1:D20, whole columns C:E or rows 3:5.

order.description: Order of day, month and year in numeric dates such as 01/02/2026 (auto: from the texts, else day first).

number_format.description: An Excel number format code ("#,##0.00", "0.0%", "\"Rp\"#,##0", "dd/mm/yyyy", "@" for text) or a preset: general (General), number (#,##0.00), integer (#,##0), decimal1 (#,##0.0), percent (0.0%), percent0 (0%), percent2 (0.00%), rupiah ("Rp"#,##0), dollar ("$"#,##0.00), euro ([$€-x-euro2] #,##0.00), date (yyyy-mm-dd), datetime (yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm), time (hh:mm), text (@).

split_column_args.description: Split the text of a one-column range at `delimiter` into the columns from `to` (default: the next column; they must be empty unless overwrite).

sheet.description: Sheet name, or its number from 1 (default: the active sheet). References such as Data!A1:B9 name their own sheet.

range.description: Cells: A1:D20, Data!A1:D20, whole columns C:E or rows 3:5.

to.description: The first cell to write to.

overwrite.description: Write over cells that aren't empty.

combine_columns_args.description: Join the columns of a range into one column at `to` with `separator`, as formulas (=A2&" "&B2) unless formulas is false.

sheet.description: Sheet name, or its number from 1 (default: the active sheet). References such as Data!A1:B9 name their own sheet.

range.description: Cells: A1:D20, Data!A1:D20, whole columns C:E or rows 3:5.

to.description: The first cell to write to.

separator.description: Put between the parts (default a space).

formulas.description: Write formulas such as =A2&" "&B2 (default true) or the joined text.

find_replace_args.description: Replace text in cells of a range, a sheet or every sheet (`all_sheets`). Formulas are left alone unless in_formulas.

sheet.description: Sheet name, or its number from 1 (default: the active sheet). References such as Data!A1:B9 name their own sheet.

range.description: Cells: A1:D20, Data!A1:D20, whole columns C:E or rows 3:5.

whole_cell.description: The whole cell must match (default false).

add_table_args.description: Make a range an Excel table (a ListObject with a style, filter buttons and an optional total row).

sheet.description: Sheet name, or its number from 1 (default: the active sheet). References such as Data!A1:B9 name their own sheet.

range.description: Cells: A1:D20, Data!A1:D20, whole columns C:E or rows 3:5.

name.description: Table name (letters, digits, _; default Table1, Table2...).

style.description: TableStyleLight1-21, TableStyleMedium1-28 (default TableStyleMedium2), TableStyleDark1-11, or none.

header.description: The range's first row is a header (default: sort and remove_duplicates guess, add_table assumes true).

totals.description: true adds a total row; or column names to functions: sum, average, count, count_numbers, max, min, stddev, var, none.

add_chart_args.description: Add a chart of cell ranges: column, bar, line, area, pie, doughnut, scatter or combo, placed by cell anchor (see `kantor sheets schema`).

sheet.description: Sheet name, or its number from 1 (default: the active sheet). References such as Data!A1:B9 name their own sheet.

at.description: Top-left cell of the chart (default: two columns right of `data`).

to.description: Bottom-right cell the chart covers (inclusive), e.g. at G2, to N18.

w.description: Width / height when `to` isn't given: a number in `units` or a string such as "6in" or "480px".

h.description: Width / height when `to` isn't given: a number in `units` or a string such as "6in" or "480px".

units.description: What bare numbers in lengths mean (default emu). Strings such as "1in" always say their unit.

data.description: A block of cells: series names along the top row, categories down the first column (text or dates; a scatter chart's x values), one series per column. E.g. Data!A1:C13.

series_in.description: The block's series are its columns (default) or rows.

chart.description: Chart type. combo: columns with lines/areas (series `type`, `axis`).

stacked.description: Column, bar, line, area: stack the series (true / "stacked") or stack to 100% ("percent").

categories.description: With `series`: the category labels' cells (Data!A2:A13), or a list of labels.

name.description: The series' name: text, or a cell with = (=Data!B1).

values.description: The values' cells (Data!B2:B13), or numbers. With `data`, leave it out: the entries then only style the block's series.

color.description: #RRGGBB (also #RGB, or #RRGGBBAA with opacity), a theme colour (accent1-accent6, tx1, tx2, bg1, bg2, dk1, lt1, dk2, lt2, hlink, folHlink), or {color, opacity}.

anyOf.description: #RRGGBB (also #RGB, or #RRGGBBAA with opacity), a theme colour (accent1-accent6, tx1, tx2, bg1, bg2, dk1, lt1, dk2, lt2, hlink, folHlink), or {color, opacity}.

colors.description: Bars or slices of their own colour, one per category (null: the series colour).

type.description: Combo (or column/line/area chart): this series' type (combo default: first column, others line).

line.description: A line series' line: width, dash, colour.

allOf.description: "none", a colour, or {color, opacity, width, dash (solid, dash, sysDash, dot, lgDash, dashDot, ...), head, tail (arrowheads: triangle, stealth, diamond, oval, arrow, or {type, width, length} small|medium|large), cap (flat|round)}.

data_labels.description: Data labels: true (values; pie/doughnut: percentages), false, or {show: value|percent|category|series or a list, position: center|inside_end|inside_base|outside_end|left|right|above|below|best_fit, number_format (or format; e.g. "#,##0", "0.0%"; default: the chart's number_format), size, bold, italic, color (#RRGGBB)}.

number_format.description: The labels' number format, e.g. "#,##0" or "0.0%" (default: the chart's number_format; pie percentages: 0%).

series.description: The series: {name, values, color, colors, type, axis, line, data_labels}.

legend.description: Default: bottom with several series or a pie, else none.

data_labels.description: Data labels: true (values; pie/doughnut: percentages), false, or {show: value|percent|category|series or a list, position: center|inside_end|inside_base|outside_end|left|right|above|below|best_fit, number_format (or format; e.g. "#,##0", "0.0%"; default: the chart's number_format), size, bold, italic, color (#RRGGBB)}.

number_format.description: The labels' number format, e.g. "#,##0" or "0.0%" (default: the chart's number_format; pie percentages: 0%).

Excel number format of the values: the default of the value axis' and the data labels' number_format, written as Excel stores it: "#,##0.0", "0%", "\"Rp\" #,##0". `,` is the thousands and `.` the decimal separator in the code; PowerPoint and Excel show them in the viewer's locale (Indonesian: 1.234,5).

axis.description: The value axis (horizontal in a bar chart).

number_format.description: Tick label format, e.g. "#,##0" or "0%" (default: the values' number_format).

reverse.description: Values (categories) in reverse order. A bar chart's categories reversed (first at the top) keep the value axis at the bottom.

visible.description: false hides the axis (line, ticks and labels); default true.

category_axis.description: The category axis: title, reverse, visible (scatter: the x axis, with min/max/major_unit).

number_format.description: Tick label format, e.g. "#,##0" or "0%" (default: the values' number_format).

reverse.description: Values (categories) in reverse order. A bar chart's categories reversed (first at the top) keep the value axis at the bottom.

visible.description: false hides the axis (line, ticks and labels); default true.

gap_width.description: Column/bar: gap between categories, % of a bar (default 150).

overlap.description: Column/bar: overlap of a category's bars in % (stacked: 100).

font.description: The chart's text (default: the deck's typeface and colour).

color.description: #RRGGBB (also #RGB, or #RRGGBBAA with opacity), a theme colour (accent1-accent6, tx1, tx2, bg1, bg2, dk1, lt1, dk2, lt2, hlink, folHlink), or {color, opacity}.

anyOf.description: #RRGGBB (also #RGB, or #RRGGBBAA with opacity), a theme colour (accent1-accent6, tx1, tx2, bg1, bg2, dk1, lt1, dk2, lt2, hlink, folHlink), or {color, opacity}.

colors.description: A one-series column, bar, pie or doughnut chart: each bar's or slice's colour (null: automatic), e.g. to highlight bars below target.

target_line.description: A dashed horizontal line at a value (column, line, area, combo): a number or {value, label (default Target), color, width, dash}. It is a line series, so it shows in the legend and in Edit Data.

color.description: #RRGGBB (also #RGB, or #RRGGBBAA with opacity), a theme colour (accent1-accent6, tx1, tx2, bg1, bg2, dk1, lt1, dk2, lt2, hlink, folHlink), or {color, opacity}.

width.description: A length: a number in `units` (default emu: 914400 per inch, 12700 per point, 360000 per cm) or a string with a unit: "1.5in", "2.5cm", "40mm", "18pt", "120px", "914400emu".

add_conditional_format_args.description: Add a conditional format to a range: data_bar, color_scale, icon_set, cell_value, text, top, bottom, above_average, below_average, duplicates, unique, blanks, not_blanks, formula or dates.

sheet.description: Sheet name, or its number from 1 (default: the active sheet). References such as Data!A1:B9 name their own sheet.

range.description: Cells: A1:D20, Data!A1:D20, whole columns C:E or rows 3:5.

operator.description: cell_value: >, <, >=, <=, =, !=, between, not_between. text: contains, not_contains, begins_with, ends_with, equals.

value.description: cell_value: the bound(s): a number, text or =formula.

value2.description: cell_value: the bound(s): a number, text or =formula.

formula.description: formula: true for the cells to format, written for the range's first cell (=$D2>100).

colors.description: color_scale: red_yellow_green (default), green_yellow_red, red_white_green, green_white_red, red_white_blue, blue_white_red, white_green, white_red, or 2-3 colours, the lowest value's first.

show_value.description: data_bar / icon_set: show the cell's value too (default true).

icons.description: icon_set: arrows (default), arrows_gray, triangles, arrows4, arrows5, traffic_lights, traffic_lights4, signs, symbols, flags, stars, ratings (or Excel's names, 3Arrows...).

format.description: What matching cells look like: red (default: light red fill, dark red text), yellow, green, red_fill, red_text, bold, or {fill, font_color, bold, italic, underline, strike}.

stop_if_true.description: Later rules don't apply to cells this one matched.

clear_conditional_formats_args.description: Remove the conditional formats of a range (or the whole sheet).

sheet.description: Sheet name, or its number from 1 (default: the active sheet). References such as Data!A1:B9 name their own sheet.

range.description: Cells: A1:D20, Data!A1:D20, whole columns C:E or rows 3:5.

add_validation_args.description: Add data validation to a range: a drop-down `list`, whole, decimal, date, time, text_length or custom, with an input message and error alert.

sheet.description: Sheet name, or its number from 1 (default: the active sheet). References such as Data!A1:B9 name their own sheet.

range.description: Cells: A1:D20, Data!A1:D20, whole columns C:E or rows 3:5.

source.description: list: the cells holding the choices, e.g. Lists!A2:A20.

value.description: The bound(s): a number, a date (2026-01-31), a time (9:30) or =formula.

value2.description: The bound(s): a number, a date (2026-01-31), a time (9:30) or =formula.

formula.description: custom: a formula true for allowed values, e.g. =LEN(A2)=8.

dropdown.description: list: show the drop-down arrow (default true).

clear_validation_args.description: Remove data validation from a range.

sheet.description: Sheet name, or its number from 1 (default: the active sheet). References such as Data!A1:B9 name their own sheet.

range.description: Cells: A1:D20, Data!A1:D20, whole columns C:E or rows 3:5.

define_name_args.description: Define a name for cells (`refers_to`, e.g. "Data!$B$2:$B$100"), for the workbook or one `sheet`.

refers_to.description: The cells it names, e.g. Data!$B$2:$B$100 (names of constants or formulas aren't supported: name a cell holding the value).

sheet.description: Sheet name, or its number from 1 (default: the active sheet). References such as Data!A1:B9 name their own sheet.
Sheet name, or its number from 1 (default: the active sheet). References such as Data!A1:B9 name their own sheet.

add_pivot_args.description: Add a pivot table of a range or table (its header row names the fields) at a cell or on a new sheet, with rows, columns, values and filters by field name.

source.description: The data: a range with a header row (Data!A1:F500) or a table name.

at.description: The pivot table's top-left cell, e.g. Summary!H2 (or give new_sheet).

new_sheet.description: Put it on a new sheet with this name (the default is a new sheet).

values.description: What to add up: field names, or {field, func: sum|count|average|max|min|product|count_numbers|stddev|stddevp|var|varp, name, number_format}.

grand_totals.description: Grand total row and column (default true).

page_setup_args.description: Set how a sheet prints (and draws as PDF/PNG): orientation, paper, fit to pages, scale, print area, title rows, gridlines, centring.

sheet.description: Sheet name, or its number from 1 (default: the active sheet). References such as Data!A1:B9 name their own sheet.

paper.description: a4, letter, legal, f4, a3, a5, or WxHmm / WxHin.

fit.description: "width" (one page wide), "page" (one page), "none", or [pages wide, pages tall] (0: any).

print_area.description: The range printed ("" for the whole sheet).

title_rows.description: Rows repeated at the top of each page, e.g. "1" or "1:2".

center.description: Centre the sheet across the page.

op.description: One editing tool and its arguments, as `kantor sheets edit FILE TOOL ARGS` takes them.

columns.description: The data column by column from `start` (each inner array is a column).

autofit.description: true fits every used column to its contents; or the columns to fit.

freeze.description: The first cell that scrolls ("B2": row 1 and column A stay), or {rows, columns}.

formats.description: Formats, each {range, ...} as the format tool takes them.

items.description: Format a range: font, size, bold, colours, fill, alignment, wrap, number format (a preset or any Excel code), indent, rotation, borders, merge.

merge.description: true merges the range (Merge & Center), false unmerges it.

range.description: Cells: A1:D20, Data!A1:D20, whole columns C:E or rows 3:5.

font_size_delta.description: Grow (or shrink) the font by this many points.

number_format.description: An Excel number format code ("#,##0.00", "0.0%", "\"Rp\"#,##0", "dd/mm/yyyy", "@" for text) or a preset: general (General), number (#,##0.00), integer (#,##0), decimal1 (#,##0.0), percent (0.0%), percent0 (0%), percent2 (0.00%), rupiah ("Rp"#,##0), dollar ("$"#,##0.00), euro ([$€-x-euro2] #,##0.00), date (yyyy-mm-dd), datetime (yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm), time (hh:mm), text (@).

rotation.description: Text angle in degrees, -90 to 90 (counter-clockwise), or 255 for stacked letters.

borders.description: Borders: all, outline, inside, top, bottom, left, right, inside_horizontal, inside_vertical, none; or {edges, style (thin, medium, thick, double, dotted, dashed, hair, dashDot, ...), color}; or a list of these.

tables.description: Excel tables, each as add_table takes it.

items.description: Make a range an Excel table (a ListObject with a style, filter buttons and an optional total row).

range.description: Cells: A1:D20, Data!A1:D20, whole columns C:E or rows 3:5.

name.description: Table name (letters, digits, _; default Table1, Table2...).

style.description: TableStyleLight1-21, TableStyleMedium1-28 (default TableStyleMedium2), TableStyleDark1-11, or none.

header.description: The range's first row is a header (default: sort and remove_duplicates guess, add_table assumes true).

totals.description: true adds a total row; or column names to functions: sum, average, count, count_numbers, max, min, stddev, var, none.

charts.description: Charts, each as add_chart takes it (`at`/`to` place it on this sheet).

items.description: Add a chart of cell ranges: column, bar, line, area, pie, doughnut, scatter or combo, placed by cell anchor (see `kantor sheets schema`).

target_line.description: A dashed horizontal line at a value (column, line, area, combo): a number or {value, label (default Target), color, width, dash}. It is a line series, so it shows in the legend and in Edit Data.

color.description: #RRGGBB (also #RGB, or #RRGGBBAA with opacity), a theme colour (accent1-accent6, tx1, tx2, bg1, bg2, dk1, lt1, dk2, lt2, hlink, folHlink), or {color, opacity}.

width.description: A length: a number in `units` (default emu: 914400 per inch, 12700 per point, 360000 per cm) or a string with a unit: "1.5in", "2.5cm", "40mm", "18pt", "120px", "914400emu".

at.description: Top-left cell of the chart (default: two columns right of `data`).

to.description: Bottom-right cell the chart covers (inclusive), e.g. at G2, to N18.

w.description: Width / height when `to` isn't given: a number in `units` or a string such as "6in" or "480px".

h.description: Width / height when `to` isn't given: a number in `units` or a string such as "6in" or "480px".

units.description: What bare numbers in lengths mean (default emu). Strings such as "1in" always say their unit.

data.description: A block of cells: series names along the top row, categories down the first column (text or dates; a scatter chart's x values), one series per column. E.g. Data!A1:C13.

series_in.description: The block's series are its columns (default) or rows.

chart.description: Chart type. combo: columns with lines/areas (series `type`, `axis`).

stacked.description: Column, bar, line, area: stack the series (true / "stacked") or stack to 100% ("percent").

categories.description: With `series`: the category labels' cells (Data!A2:A13), or a list of labels.

name.description: The series' name: text, or a cell with = (=Data!B1).

values.description: The values' cells (Data!B2:B13), or numbers. With `data`, leave it out: the entries then only style the block's series.

color.description: #RRGGBB (also #RGB, or #RRGGBBAA with opacity), a theme colour (accent1-accent6, tx1, tx2, bg1, bg2, dk1, lt1, dk2, lt2, hlink, folHlink), or {color, opacity}.

anyOf.description: #RRGGBB (also #RGB, or #RRGGBBAA with opacity), a theme colour (accent1-accent6, tx1, tx2, bg1, bg2, dk1, lt1, dk2, lt2, hlink, folHlink), or {color, opacity}.

colors.description: Bars or slices of their own colour, one per category (null: the series colour).

type.description: Combo (or column/line/area chart): this series' type (combo default: first column, others line).

line.description: A line series' line: width, dash, colour.

allOf.description: "none", a colour, or {color, opacity, width, dash (solid, dash, sysDash, dot, lgDash, dashDot, ...), head, tail (arrowheads: triangle, stealth, diamond, oval, arrow, or {type, width, length} small|medium|large), cap (flat|round)}.

data_labels.description: Data labels: true (values; pie/doughnut: percentages), false, or {show: value|percent|category|series or a list, position: center|inside_end|inside_base|outside_end|left|right|above|below|best_fit, number_format (or format; e.g. "#,##0", "0.0%"; default: the chart's number_format), size, bold, italic, color (#RRGGBB)}.

number_format.description: The labels' number format, e.g. "#,##0" or "0.0%" (default: the chart's number_format; pie percentages: 0%).

series.description: The series: {name, values, color, colors, type, axis, line, data_labels}.

legend.description: Default: bottom with several series or a pie, else none.

data_labels.description: Data labels: true (values; pie/doughnut: percentages), false, or {show: value|percent|category|series or a list, position: center|inside_end|inside_base|outside_end|left|right|above|below|best_fit, number_format (or format; e.g. "#,##0", "0.0%"; default: the chart's number_format), size, bold, italic, color (#RRGGBB)}.

number_format.description: The labels' number format, e.g. "#,##0" or "0.0%" (default: the chart's number_format; pie percentages: 0%).

Excel number format of the values: the default of the value axis' and the data labels' number_format, written as Excel stores it: "#,##0.0", "0%", "\"Rp\" #,##0". `,` is the thousands and `.` the decimal separator in the code; PowerPoint and Excel show them in the viewer's locale (Indonesian: 1.234,5).

axis.description: The value axis (horizontal in a bar chart).

number_format.description: Tick label format, e.g. "#,##0" or "0%" (default: the values' number_format).

reverse.description: Values (categories) in reverse order. A bar chart's categories reversed (first at the top) keep the value axis at the bottom.

visible.description: false hides the axis (line, ticks and labels); default true.

category_axis.description: The category axis: title, reverse, visible (scatter: the x axis, with min/max/major_unit).

number_format.description: Tick label format, e.g. "#,##0" or "0%" (default: the values' number_format).

reverse.description: Values (categories) in reverse order. A bar chart's categories reversed (first at the top) keep the value axis at the bottom.

visible.description: false hides the axis (line, ticks and labels); default true.

gap_width.description: Column/bar: gap between categories, % of a bar (default 150).

overlap.description: Column/bar: overlap of a category's bars in % (stacked: 100).

font.description: The chart's text (default: the deck's typeface and colour).

color.description: #RRGGBB (also #RGB, or #RRGGBBAA with opacity), a theme colour (accent1-accent6, tx1, tx2, bg1, bg2, dk1, lt1, dk2, lt2, hlink, folHlink), or {color, opacity}.

anyOf.description: #RRGGBB (also #RGB, or #RRGGBBAA with opacity), a theme colour (accent1-accent6, tx1, tx2, bg1, bg2, dk1, lt1, dk2, lt2, hlink, folHlink), or {color, opacity}.

colors.description: A one-series column, bar, pie or doughnut chart: each bar's or slice's colour (null: automatic), e.g. to highlight bars below target.

conditional_formats.description: Conditional formats, each as add_conditional_format takes it.

items.description: Add a conditional format to a range: data_bar, color_scale, icon_set, cell_value, text, top, bottom, above_average, below_average, duplicates, unique, blanks, not_blanks, formula or dates.

stop_if_true.description: Later rules don't apply to cells this one matched.

range.description: Cells: A1:D20, Data!A1:D20, whole columns C:E or rows 3:5.

operator.description: cell_value: >, <, >=, <=, =, !=, between, not_between. text: contains, not_contains, begins_with, ends_with, equals.

value.description: cell_value: the bound(s): a number, text or =formula.

value2.description: cell_value: the bound(s): a number, text or =formula.

formula.description: formula: true for the cells to format, written for the range's first cell (=$D2>100).

colors.description: color_scale: red_yellow_green (default), green_yellow_red, red_white_green, green_white_red, red_white_blue, blue_white_red, white_green, white_red, or 2-3 colours, the lowest value's first.

show_value.description: data_bar / icon_set: show the cell's value too (default true).

icons.description: icon_set: arrows (default), arrows_gray, triangles, arrows4, arrows5, traffic_lights, traffic_lights4, signs, symbols, flags, stars, ratings (or Excel's names, 3Arrows...).

format.description: What matching cells look like: red (default: light red fill, dark red text), yellow, green, red_fill, red_text, bold, or {fill, font_color, bold, italic, underline, strike}.

validations.description: Data validation, each as add_validation takes it.

items.description: Add data validation to a range: a drop-down `list`, whole, decimal, date, time, text_length or custom, with an input message and error alert.

range.description: Cells: A1:D20, Data!A1:D20, whole columns C:E or rows 3:5.

source.description: list: the cells holding the choices, e.g. Lists!A2:A20.

value.description: The bound(s): a number, a date (2026-01-31), a time (9:30) or =formula.

value2.description: The bound(s): a number, a date (2026-01-31), a time (9:30) or =formula.

formula.description: custom: a formula true for allowed values, e.g. =LEN(A2)=8.

dropdown.description: list: show the drop-down arrow (default true).

pivots.description: Pivot tables placed on this sheet (`at`: a cell of it), each as add_pivot takes it.

gridlines.description: Print (and draw in PDF/PNG) the gridlines.

show_gridlines.description: false hides the gridlines on screen (Excel's View > Gridlines), e.g. for a dashboard.

page_setup.description: Set how a sheet prints (and draws as PDF/PNG): orientation, paper, fit to pages, scale, print area, title rows, gridlines, centring.

center.description: Centre the sheet across the page.

paper.description: a4, letter, legal, f4, a3, a5, or WxHmm / WxHin.

fit.description: "width" (one page wide), "page" (one page), "none", or [pages wide, pages tall] (0: any).

print_area.description: The range printed ("" for the whole sheet).

title_rows.description: Rows repeated at the top of each page, e.g. "1" or "1:2".

ops.description: Any editing tools, run on this sheet after the rest.
